items.title: LATAM Refused My Refund Within 24 Hours, And The Reason Makes No Sense
items.why: A traveler says LATAM denied a refund for a ticket cancelled in time, blaming a booking mix-up on a UK credit card.

items.title: LATAM Unveils New Airbus A321XLR Business Class Suites, Coming March 2027
